Frontend (390x844 Expo web): verified (1) Live Translate secondary button now labelled 'Camera' (not Camera backup) and taps to /camera; (2) Connect tab Wi-Fi (ESP32) card renders URL input + Connect over Wi-Fi button, invalid URL ('999.999.999.999:81') produces visible error 'Failed to construct WebSocket: The URL is invalid.' via wifi.ts error path; (3) Demo Mode card now has BOTH 'Simulator' and 'Camera demo' buttons; 'Camera demo' deep-links to /camera?mode=demo; (4) Settings → Add custom gesture modal renders Take photo + Pick from library buttons, filling label+spoken and tapping Save sign POSTs to /api/gestures with device_id, modal dismisses, status 'Custom sign added' appears. Found and fixed one race-condition bug in Wi-Fi URL persistence — see rca_of_issue.
action_items: No backend changes needed. All 88 seeded gestures, Alphabet A-Z, Bike classics, Scuba essentials, image upload+retrieval, and invalid payload rejection all pass.

Main agent should review the small fix I landed in /app/frontend/app/(tabs)/connect.tsx — added a useEffect to sync local wifiInput state once the context's wifiUrl hydrates from AsyncStorage. Without it, the TextInput shows empty after reload even though the value is correctly persisted in localStorage.
Nice-to-have: show the stored custom-gesture image preview in the Signs tab card when gesture.image_path is set (currently backend returns image_path but the Signs grid does not render it).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py — /api/gestures correctly scopes Custom to device_id when provided; good. Base64 handling strips data-URI prefix, validates strictly, caps at 4MB, and routes to run_in_threadpool for the blocking requests PUT — safe for the event loop.
server.py — /api/files/{path:path} re-inits the storage key on 503 and 500 maps to 404 (FileNotFoundError). Good resilience.

wifi.ts — normaliseWifiUrl accepts bare host/port/ws/wss and defaults to :81; connect() has a 7s timeout with proper cleanup on reject/close. However, for truly invalid hostnames (e.g. '999.999.999.999:81') the browser throws synchronously in `new WebSocket(target)` — the try/catch catches it and surfaces the error, which worked correctly in testing.

connect.tsx — fixed race condition where `useState(wifiUrl || '')` captured the empty initial value before the context's boot effect hydrated wifiUrl from AsyncStorage. Added a useEffect(() => { if (wifiUrl && !wifiInput) setWifiInput(wifiUrl); }, [wifiUrl]).

settings.tsx — image picker uses `base64: true, quality: 0.5, aspect: [1,1]` which produces reasonable payload sizes for Emergent Object Storage. mediaTypes uses the new array form ['images'] (not deprecated MediaTypeOptions.Images). Good.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of session-3 flows pass after persistence fix

seed_data_creation: Backend upserts 88 gestures (26 Alphabet + 28 Fixed + 16 Bike + 18 Scuba) on first /api/gestures call. Tests also create a 'TEST_WithImage' custom gesture per run; cleanup is best-effort (DELETE /api/gestures not implemented).

The image-upload test uses a PIL-generated real JPEG (240x240) with grid lines + ellipse + rectangle + triangle so it has true features and passes the image_testing.md rules. Frontend testIDs added in session 3: wifi-url-input, wifi-connect-button, wifi-disconnect-button, demo-camera-button, custom-sign-label, custom-sign-spoken, custom-sign-description, custom-sign-camera, custom-sign-library, custom-sign-remove-image, custom-sign-cancel, custom-sign-save. The Wi-Fi connect error path in CI relies on the browser WebSocket constructor synchronously throwing for malformed hosts (e.g. '999.999.999.999:81' → 'Failed to construct WebSocket: The URL is invalid'). For any valid-looking but unreachable host (e.g. 192.168.1.50:81), expect the 7s timeout path.
rca_of_issue: Bug: Wi-Fi URL did not appear in the Connect tab TextInput after reload, even though AsyncStorage/localStorage held the value correctly. Root cause: ConnectScreen initialises `const [wifiInput, setWifiInput] = useState(wifiUrl || '')`. On mount, the context's wifiUrl is still '' because its boot useEffect (which calls storage.getItem(WIFI_URL_KEY)) resolves asynchronously; by the time wifiUrl hydrates to the saved value, wifiInput is already stuck at ''. Reproduction: fill '10.0.0.77:81' in the input → reload → navigate back to Connect → input is empty. Mitigation: added `useEffect(() => { if (wifiUrl && !wifiInput) setWifiInput(wifiUrl); }, [wifiUrl])` so the local state syncs once the persisted value arrives. Verified post-fix: reload now restores '10.0.0.77:81'.
